about: Folders of downloaded things (models, assets) that several apps or tools share, which the Store may keep on an external drive on their own (shared/forge_external.py stores()). paths are relative to the Forge folder and must hold only re-downloadable or rebuildable files: never his work (voice profiles stay out) and nothing kept in git (move() refuses those). used_by lists the apps that read it; needed true makes those apps wait with the plug-in card while the drive is away, false lets them open (code reading it calls forge_external.require for a plain message). An app's own folders go in its forge_app.json "stores" list instead. Adding one is one entry here. The asset library (shared/assets) is not listed: some of its files are kept in git.
